company.description: Gulf Navigation Holding is a shipping company involved in marine transportation of commodities and chartering vessels. Gulf Navigation Holding PJSC (GNH) is a fully integrated and synergized organization and a one-stop shop with a multi-functional business providing high quality services through its subsidiaries. It is the only shipping company listed in the Dubai Financial Market (DFM) since February 2007 under the symbol “GULFNAV”.
